analyticalQuestion: Can the full infinite charge ladder be controlled at all orders, and does the R0.29 formal factorization hold in a genuine analytic domain?
supportedClaim: For K=96, the all-order coefficient bounds A_L <= 2 K^(L-1)/L^3 and ||U_L||_1,||V_L||_1 <= K^(L-1)/L^3 give absolute analyticity on max(|Z|,|W|)<1/96. On the radius-1/192 polydisc, |U/Z-1| and |V/W-1| are at most 1/8, so the logarithms, phi, and the R0.29 factorization are analytic. The degree-119 GMP run is an implementation regression and finite kernel diagnostic, not the proof or a singularity theorem.
